statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis code I25.10 corresponds to atherosclerotic heart disease
The diagnosis code I47.1 corresponds to supraventricular tachycardia
CPT code 93226 is the code for 48-hour Holter monitor
The Holter monitor is to evaluate for intermittent arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The claim was denied based on reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
The 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary
